# Error messages

## Directives

From [Digital product development](digital-product-development.md):

- Name the user and the task of each feature before you design or build the feature. ^name-user-and-task

## Definition

The messages that tell a person that something went wrong and how to recover. Nielsen Norman Group asks for messages that are highly visible, give constructive advice, and respect the effort of the user. A message uses human-readable language and describes the exact problem.
